scopeBoundary: Research began with the two candidates left unresearched by the previous three-ADOPT stop, in the mandated order 0647 then 0238. With fewer than three ADOPTs, repository metadata only re-ranked the remaining unresearched Priority-D inventory under the established performance-oriented rule. Three additional dedicated-theater candidates were assessed in that order. Research stopped at the five-candidate ceiling; no two-pass transcription, source/range authoring, production integration, generated artifact, fingerprint, or production-total change was made.
policyBasis: ADOPT requires current/current-linked first-party evidence that defines one representative configuration with a complete issuer-numbered seat set, issuer-defined ownership/subtotals, and accessibility/removable/alternative-configuration treatment that needs no inference. DEFER covers missing IDs or unsupported configuration definition. HARD-CASE DEFER is reserved for an otherwise complete chart whose issuer subtotal or accessibility relation alone remains unreconciled. Capacity fitting, geometry-derived ownership, invented IDs, and configuration mixing are prohibited.
performanceOrientedRankingRule: Dedicated theater, concert hall, live-event hall, or auditorium with continuing performance use and likely assigned-ticket demand.
Civic/public large, medium, or small halls with explicit performance use.
Recreation, multipurpose, meeting, and conference spaces.
